items.name: Please Be Quiet Pickering 2023
items.information:
### Please be quiet

Most of the events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

### Note for new competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), 6x6x6 Cube or 7x7x7 Cube, this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.

venue.name: Autotalo
venue.details: Salomonkatu main entrance facing the metro station

items.information:
Please read through the [regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
We highly recommend not bringing any guests. However, we're required to allow 1 guest per competitor.
Competitors will be divided into two groups. **Attending the entire competition and judging/scrambling for the group you aren't competing in is mandatory.**
You may register to however many events you want, but keep in mind that the combined time limit for finishing your solves is 22 minutes. (e.g. after five 2x2 solves of 10 seconds you have 21:10 left for the remaining events) You may choose the order of the events you compete in. However, you must finish one event before starting a new one.

Lue säännöt ([englanniksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/), [suomeksi](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/finnish/)) ennen kilpailua.
Suosittelemme saapumaan ilman vieraita. Joudumme kuitenkin sallimaan yhden vieraan per kilpailija.
Kilpailijat jaetaan kahteen ryhmään. **Paikallaolo koko kilpailun ajan on pakollista ja sinun täytyy tuomaroida/sekoittaa ryhmässä jossa et kilpaile.**
Voit ilmoittautua kuinka moneen lajiin tahansa, mutta pidä mielessä, että kokonaisaikaraja kaikille ratkaisuille on 22 minuuttia. (esim. viiden 10 sekunnin 2x2 ratkaisun jälkeen aikaa lopuille lajeille on 21:10) Voit valita järjestyksen lajeille, joissa kilpailet. Edellinen laji pitää kuitenkin lopettaa ennen seuraavan aloittamista.

venue.details: Folgen Sie den Schildern, um den Veranstaltungsort zu betreten. / Follow the signs to enter the venue.

items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr, euch BF Vienna 2023 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. 

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Simon Praschl und delegiert von Šimon Borovský und Viktor Kalmar. Diesesmal findet das Turnier in den Räumlichkeiten des BMME statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier herzlich willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. 

Da dies ein sehr kleines, ruhiges und auch kurzes Turnier wird sind generell keine Gäste erlaubt (da wir auch von der Räumlichkeit begrenzt sind) - falls jedoch ein Teilnehmer einen Gast dabei haben muss, zb. weil du Minderjährig bist und deinen Erziehungsberechtigten dabei haben willst, dann schreibt uns bitte noch vor dem Turnier eine E-mail mit einer Begründung und mit dem Namen des Gastes.

Generell herrscht absolute Ruhe während des Gesamten Turnieres (ausgenommen von den Pausen) da es sich um Blind Events sowohl als auch um Fewest Moves handelt.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

We are happy to announce the BF Vienna 2023 as an official WCA Competition. 

The speedcubing competition is organised by Florian Truckenthanner and Simon Praschl and delegated by Šimon Borovský and Viktor Kalmar. The results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

This competition is going to be quite small, short and especially quiet and because of this no guests will be allowed at this competition (also because it is a small room).
If you have a good reason why a guest should accompany you (e.g.: you are a minor and you want to have your legal guardian with you), then please let us know before the competition via email (include the name of the guest and the reasoning).

It has to be absolutely quiet during the whole competition (except during the breaks) because we have Blind and Fewest Moves events only.

items.information:
### コンセプト
スピードキュービングチャレンジでは、できるだけ多くの方々に自己記録更新へと"チャレンジ"していただくことを目指しています。

昨今のWCA大会では参加定員を大幅に上回る申し込みが寄せられ、参加希望者を十分に受け入れられない状態が頻発しています。
この状況を緩和するため、1種目1ラウンドのみでシリーズ大会を開催し、総参加者数の増大をねらいます。
#### **BLD I大会の開催種目は 3x3x3 目隠し (1ラウンド) のみです。通常の 3x3x3 キューブ の競技はありません。同日開催のIV大会かV大会にお申し込みください。**

### WCAシリーズ大会
WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。
複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。

Tokyo Challenge BLD I 2023(**本大会 / 以下、BLD I大会**) 、[Tokyo Challenge IV 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeIV2023)(**以下、IV大会**) 及び[Tokyo Challenge V 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeV2023)(**以下、V大会**) はWCA シリーズ大会です。
BLD I大会、IV大会およびV大会のうち１つの大会だけに参加できます。


### 競技参加者以外の来場要件
**限られた会場広さで、できるだけ多くの競技者に参加できるようにしてもらうため、同伴者及び見学者に制限を設けております。**
当日飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。
**未成年の競技者に対する保護者同伴は、1名とさせていただきます(無料)。18歳以上の競技者は、同伴者なしで来場いただくよう、ご協力をお願いいたします。**
もし追加で同伴者として来場する必要がある場合は、見学者としてお申し込みください。(1000円/1人)
また、会場内の人数制限のため、見学をお断りする場合がございます。あらかじめご了承ください。

### サポーター募集
より継続的かつ安定的にスピードキュービングチャレンジをするためには大会を成立させるための運営側に人手が必要となります。そこで運営に興味のある競技者や、競技者の保護者の方に「サポーター」として活躍していただきたく思います。サポーターの役割は大会当日の会場設営、受付、呼び出し、記録入力・印刷、机消毒、撤収作業等になります。サポーターご自身の競技やお子さまの活躍の応援に影響の出ない範囲内でご協力していただきます。
後日サポーターの募集のご案内をさせていただきます。

### Concept
Speed Cubing Challenge aims to "challenge" as many people as possible to break their own records.

In recent years, WCA competition has received far more applications than it can accommodate, and it is frequently the case that there are not enough applicants to accommodate all of them.
To alleviate this situation, we aim to increase the total number of participants by holding series competitions with only one event, one round.
#### **The BLD I competitions are held in 3x3x3 blindfold only (1 round). There will be no regular 3x3x3 Cube competition. Please register for the IV or V competitions held on the same day.**


### WCA Series Competitions
WCA series Competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can **only** participate in one of them.
If you apply for more than one series, only the one with the earliest application date will be accepted, and the others will be invalid.

Tokyo Challenge BLD I 2023 (**This Competition / hereinafter referred to as "Competition BLD I"**), [Tokyo Challenge IV 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeIV2023) (**Competition IV**) and [Tokyo Challenge V 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokyoChallengeV2023) (**Competition V**) are WCA series competitions.
You can participate in only one of the BLD I, IV and V competitions.

### Requirements for non-competitors
**Space is limited in the venue and our priority is allowing as many competitors as possible to compete within our limited venue space.**
It is not possible to watch the competition on the day of the event.
**Competitors may bring at most one (1) guest. Competitors over the age of 18 are encouraged to come without a guest.** 
If you need additional guest, please register as a visitor.　(1,000 yen per visitors)
Please note that due to the limited number of people in the venue, visitors may not be allowed to visit. 

### Supporters Wanted
In order to make Speed Cubing Challenge more sustainable and stable, we need people to support the event. Therefore, we would like to ask competitors and parents of competitors who are interested in supporting the event to become "supporters". The role of a supporter on the day of the event will be to set up the venue, reception, call-outs, input and print records, disinfect the tables, and clean up. Supporters are asked to cooperate within the scope that does not affect their own competitions or their children's competitions.
We will inform you of how to apply for supporters at a later date.

items.name: Save Ramir Cubing Kazakhstan 2023
items.information:
Соревнование проводится с благотворительной целью. Все вырученные средства пойдут в помощь сбору средств на лечение 3-летнего ребенка с инвалидностью Рамира Ковалевского, с диагнозом «Спинальная мышечная атрофия 2 типа», который нуждается в  самом дорогостоящем лекарственном препарате в мире, ZOLGENSMA.

Главный спонсор соревнования – компания «Леовит». Соревнование проводится при поддержке школы №157 и общественного фонда «Alem Asar».. 

Смотрите наш аккаунт в Instagram (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers), чтобы узнавать новости и подробную информацию о соревновании!

Соревнование будет проходить в спортзале школы №157.

Будем рады видеть вас на соревновании! 

Жарыс қайырымдылық мақсатында өткізеді. Жарыстан бүкіл түскен қаражат спиналды бұлшық атрофия диагнозына шалдыққан мүгедекке 3 жасар бала Рамир Ковалевскийге әлемде ең бағалы дәрі «ZOLGENSMA» сатып алу үшін қаржы жинауға және көмектесуге бағыттайды

Жарыстың бас демеушісі – «Леовит» компаниясы. Жарыс мектептiң №157 мен «Alem Asar» қоғамдық қорының көмегiмен өткiзіледi. 

Біздің Instagram аккаунтымыздың парақшасында (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) жаңалықтар және жарыс туралы ақпарат көре аласыздар!

Жарыс мектептің №157 спорт залында өткізіледі.

Сіздің жарысқа белсенді ат салысып қатысқаныңызға қуаныштымыз! 


 
The competition is organised for charity. All the proceeds made from the competition will be spent for fundraising for helping 3-years old kid, Ramir Kovalevsky, in his spinal muscular atrophy medical treatment to purchase him the most expensive cure in the world, ZOLGENSMA.

The Leovit company is the main sponsor of the competition. The competition is organised with the help of school #157 and Alem Asar social foundation.

Watch our posts in our Instagram account (https://instagram.com/almaty_cubers) to learn the news and more information about the competition! 

The competition will be set in the sports hall of the school #157.

We will be happy to see you at the competition!

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners

items.name: Please Be Quiet Joburg 2023
items.information:
### This is not a normal competition

We won't be holding any normal events. This competition is focused on blindfolded events, with a single fewest move attempt to keep things interesting.

If you have not competed before, this may not be the best experience for your first competition. Sign up at [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) to get notifications for other competitions in your province.

**Please be quiet**. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund.

### Venue

The venue is in a private venue in Bryanston. Access for all competitors and guests need to be arranged in advance. Failure to do so will result in you or your guests being denied access to the venue.
There is limited parking that needs to be arranged in advance. **All competitors** must please provide the following information:

1. If you will be arriving by car, please provide registration number.
2. If you will be getting a lift with someone, please provide the name of the person you will be getting a lift with.
3. If using an Uber or other transport, please indicate this.

Once you have provided this information, you will be given the exact address.

### Guests

Competitors may bring only one guest due to venue constraints. If a competitor is bringing a guest, then they must provide the full name and surname. 

### About CubingZA

Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact). We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.name: Vardagscubing IV - Gamla Uppsala 2023
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den fjärde svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 21 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Notera dock att varje deltagare denna gång **får välja maximalt fem (5) grenar** att tävla i. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **tisdag** pågår endast i drygt 3 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

Welcome to the fourth Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each competitor has a total of 21 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. Note, however, that each competitor this time **can choose a maximum of five (5) events** to compete in. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Tuesday**, lasts only roughly 3 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

## London Winter 2023 Series

The London Winter 2023 Series is a collaboration between the **Western University Cube Club** and **Speedcubing Canada**.  

This competition is in a series with [London Winter A 2023](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LondonWinterA2023). You will only be able to compete in *one* of these two competitions. Attempting to register for both of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.

## Registration Reminder

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

## Mailing List

Speedcubing Canada is aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

## Notice of Filming and Photography

Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Vardagscubing III - Ålidenskolan Open B 2023
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den tredje svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, i samarbete med Ålidenskolan i Flen! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 18 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som hålls på en **fredag**, pågår endast i 3,5 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

**OBS:** Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Flen denna dag.

--

A warm welcome to the third Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, in collaboration with Ålidenskolan in Flen! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 18 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Friday**, lasts only 3,5 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

**N.B:** Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Flen that day.

# 🇺🇾
Hay un límite de 35 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24769-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24770-competidores-nuevos-new-competitors).
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

# 🇬🇧
Competitor limit: 35.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24769-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24770-competidores-nuevos-new-competitors).
* Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* It is important to read all the information available in the competition website.

Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.information:
Another competition to be held at UC Berkeley!

Berkeley Winter B in particular also happens to be held during Chinese New Year! Scorecards will look slightly different to normal competitions in the Bay Area as a result!

This competition will be following unique precautions to protect competitors and spectators against COVID-19. We kindly ask you to read the **COVID SAFETY** tab before registering. Please also familiarize yourself with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and the [WCA Competition Safety Policy](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Competition%20Safety.pdf).

**Competition Day Timing**
- The competition will begin at the scheduled start time.
- Lunch will end at the scheduled time. 
- Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. 
- Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
## Competitors are limited to ONE guest. Spectators who are not associated with a registered competitor will NOT be permitted to enter the venue.

## You will only be able to register for one of Berkeley Winter A 2023 or Berkeley Winter B 2023. If you register for both, we will only be accepting your registration for the first one you signed up for.

items.name: The Sides Bahia Experience 2023

venue.name: Residência Privada
venue.details: O Endereço será enviado aos competidores assim que o pagamento for confirmado

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes.
Esta competição será realizada em um formato diferente do tradicional, neste campeonato, os competidores terão uma hora de limite para fazer todos os eventos que quiserem na ordem em que desejarem. Em um grupo serão juízes, no outro, competidores e em outro, embaralhadores.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners
This competition will happen in a format different from the traditional, at this competition, the competitors will have an hour to do all the events they want in the order they want. In a group they will be judges, on the other, competitors and in a last one, scramblers.

**HAVERÁ PREMIAÇÕES EXTRAS: INICIANTES, FEMININO, MAIS NOVOS E MAIS VELHOS**

**THERE WILL BE EXTRA AWARDS FOR: NEWCOMERS, FEMALES, YOUNGEST AND OLDEST CUBERS**
**THIS TIME THERE WILL BE THE JUVENILE CATEGORIES, IN WHICH IT WILL BE AWARDED THE BEST ON EACH EVENT WITH AN AGE UNDER 16 YEARS**

REGISTRO
A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:

Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites;
Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicando o nome completo do participante;
Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Serão aceitas inscrições no dia da competição para as modalidades 2x2 e 3x3, no valor de R$ 30,00;
Há um limite de 40 competidores
Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (jvinicius@worldcubeassociation.org).

REGISTRATION
The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:

Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition;
Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind.
Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br) indicating the participant's full name;
Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned. Registrations will not be accepted on the day of the competition;
There will be a limit of 40 competitors.
For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (joaoszme@yahoo.com.br)

A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 50 primeiros pagantes.

The **payment** of the registration fee must be made **in advance**. All the relevant instructions can be found under the register tab.

The registration **WILL NOT** be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to competed at the day of the competition.

items.name: Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022
items.information:
Välkommen till Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är din chans att bli av med de extra kalorierna från julmaten de närmasta dagarna innan tävlingen! Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen.

### Vänligen notera:
* **3x3x3 FMC kan inte kombineras med någon annan gren. 4x4x4 BLD och 5x5x5 BLD kan inte kombineras med 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (och vice versa).**
* **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 30 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information.
* **Lokalen ligger i en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret.
* **Notera att du bara får anmäla dig till (och delta på) en av de två tävlingarna som hålls i Stockholm denna dag.**

---

Welcome to Vardagscubing II - Hive A 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is your chance to work off some of those extra calories from the Christmas food of the past few days! Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition.

### Please note: 
* **3x3x3 FMC can not be combined with any other event. 4x4x4 BLD and 5x5x5 BLD can not be combined with 3x3x3 Multi-Blind (and vice versa).**
* **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 30 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information.
* **The venue is an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office.
* **Note that you may only register for (and participate in) one of the two competitions held in Stockholm that day.**

# 🇺🇾
Hay un límite de 35 competidores para el registro.

* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1).
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia.

Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA.

* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.

* Competitors must bring their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb29qIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3fd3ee04cc4342b100336569c99d7ef80ddb3f0e/Logo%20Macro%20a%20color%20con%20fondo%20de%20cubos%20y%20letras%20blancas%20.png)
# ¡BIENVENIDOS AL MACRO MONTERREY 2022!
Torneo oficial que se realizará en el Museo Metropolitano de Monterrey, lugar emblemático de la capital regiomontana que tiene más de 100 años de existencia en los que tuvo varias funciones, como ser la sede del gobierno municipal, y siendo actualmente el hogar de resguardo de 300 piezas históricas.

Ahora, pasa a ser el sitio oficial para esta competencia que es la segunda parte de la **Ruta Regia**.

Te invitamos a formar parte de este torneo que se celebrará en el centro de la ciudad, que será abierto a todos los participantes que deseen competir. Esperamos que puedas asistir.

> Todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados con el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a) al participar en esta competencia.



# ¡WELCOME TO MACRO MONTERREY 2022!
Official tournament that will take place at the Museo Metropolitano de Monterrey, an emblematic place in the capital of Nuevo Leon that has existed for more than 100 years in which it had many functions, such as being the place of the municipal government, and currently has 300 historical pieces.

Now, it becomes the official place for this competition, which is the second part of the **Ruta Regia**.

We invite you to be part of this tournament that will be held in the center of the city, which is open to anyone. We hope you can attend.

> All competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/#2a)

items.name: Please Be Solved Pickering 2022
items.information:
### Blindfolded events only

The only events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate.

### FMC Canada connection

This competition will be held during the morning/early afternoon on the same day as [FMC Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2022) in the same venue as the Pickering, ON location. You are welcome to register for one or both competitions, but please note that you would need to ***register for FMC Canada separately***.

### Note for new competitors

Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you.

items.name: Vardagscubing I - Uppsala 2022
items.information:
Varmt välkommen till den första svenska upplagan av Vardagscubing, denna gång i Uppsala! Tävlingen har ett väldigt speciellt upplägg, där varje deltagare har totalt 20 minuter i lösningstid på sig att genomföra alla sina lösningar, och deltagaren får själv välja vilka grenar man vill spendera sin tid på. Tävlingen, som denna gång går på en **måndag** pågår endast i 4 timmar. 

Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida (särskilt "Vardagscubing") så du inte missar någon viktig information.

**OBS:** Anmäler du dig till antingen 3x3x3 FMC eller 3x3x3 Multi-Blind så kan du endast tävla i just den grenen och inte tävla i någon annan gren på tävlingen.

--

Welcome to the first Swedish edition of Vardagscubing, this time in Uppsala! The competition has a very special format, where each participant has a total of 20 minutes of solving time to complete all their solves, and the competitor gets to choose which events to spend their time on. The competition, which this time takes place on a **Monday**, lasts only 4 hours.

Please read through all the tabs on this page (especially "Vardagscubing") so you don't miss any important information.

**N.B.:** If you register for either 3x3x3 FMC or 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you can only compete in that particular event and not compete in any other event at the competition.

items.information:
## Registration Reminders

You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details.

All competitors must be available to judge and scramble at this competition. Please read the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NewmarketSideEvents2022#21475-competitor-responsibilities).

## Nearby Competitions

Newmarket Side Events 2022 features "side events" and will not have the standard 3x3x3 Cube as an event. If you are looking to compete in 3x3x3 Cube, please consider registering for [Oakville Fall A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OakvilleFallA2022) *or* [Oakville Fall B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/OakvilleFallB2022).

## Mailing List

We are aware of the extremely high demand for competitions in Ontario. We are working hard to meet and keep up with the demand and are regularly planning and announcing more and larger competitions. Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](http://speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. Thank you for your patience during this time as we work to scale up to the exciting growth of the cubing community.

Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition;

11/3に行われるAyase Autumn A 2022(**本大会 / 以下、A大会**) と11/6に行われる[Ayase Autumn B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AyaseAutumnB2022) (以下、B大会) は 、WCA シリーズ大会です。
### シリーズ大会では、そのうち１つだけに参加できます。
複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。

なお、A大会とB大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。
**A大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 3x3x3 目隠し / スクエア1 / スキューブ / クロック / 3x3x3複数 目隠し**
B大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 5x5x5 キューブ / 6x6x6 キューブ / メガミンクス (2ラウンド)

新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。
飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。

会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**見学申請は、競技参加者１名につき同伴者１名**に制限しています。
競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴や、その他**一般からの見学申請は受け付けておりません。**
また、見学希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先する場合があります。

### 会場についての注意 ###
今回の会場は集会室1,2共に**靴を脱いで**利用する部屋となります。そのため、衛生上の観点から競技者及び見学者の方は**靴下の着用**をお願いします。

Ayase Autumn A 2022 (**This competition, A**) and [Ayase Autumn B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AyaseAutumnB2022) (B) are WCA Series Competitions. 
### You can register either of these series competitions.  
If you register for multiple competitions, only the earliest one will be received, and the others will be rejected.

Please make sure that the events for A and B are different.
**A: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 3x3x3 blindfolded / Square-1 / Skewb / Clock / 3x3x3 Multi-Blind**
B: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 5x5x5 Cube / 6x6x6 Cube / Megaminx (2 round)

The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure.
**Only the companions of competitors are allowed to enter the venue as spectators.**
Being mindful of space, we can only accept requests of  **1 companion at MAX per competitor.**
If the number of requests would become too many,  a certain prioritization might be applied. (Ex. Guardians for minors)

### Attention ###
In room 1 and 2,  you have to take off your shoes. So, you must wear socks due to hygienic reasons.

items.information:
Välkomna till Svenska Mästerskapen 2022! 

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 7 sekunder eller 5 minuter. 

Det blir i år en 2,5-dagarstävling med alla WCA-grenar utom en, 3x3x3 FMC. Den Svenska Mästaren i den grenen kommer krönas på den separata tävlingen [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022).

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

Tävlande av alla nationaliteter är välkomna, men bara deltagare som representerar Sverige kan vinna medaljer, priser och titeln Svensk Mästare.

*Notera vänligen också att klockan ställs* ***tillbaka*** *en timme till vintertid i Sverige natten mot söndag den 30:e oktober, vilket betyder en timmes längre sömn!*

-----

Welcome to the Swedish Championship 2022!

Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 7 seconds or 5 minutes.

This year there will be a 2,5-day competition with all WCA events but one, 3x3x3 FMC. The Swedish Champion in this event will be crowned at the separate competition [Swedish FMC Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SwedishFMCChampionship2022).

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

Competitors of all nationalities are welcome, but only participants representing Sweden can win medals, prizes and the title of Swedish Champion.

*Please also note that the clock is set* ***back*** *one hour to winter time in Sweden on the night before Sunday October 30th, which means an hour more sleep!*

items.name: Kewbz UK Championship 2022
items.information:
## Welcome to Kewbz UK Championship 2022!
### This year's UK National Championship


##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Spectators and Guests](#22468-spectators-and-guests) tab.

If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

**Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Kewbz UK Championship 2022, you'll receive a completely free UK Championship t-shirt as a memento! You will receive this on registration at the venue, where you can choose your size.

**Guests:** Guests will **only** be permitted to attend by paying a **£5** fee **at the competition**. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** The fee must be paid at the competition and cannot be prepaid beforehand. The guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only, the fee must be paid at the competition.

**Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements in an official WCA competition by *17th October 2022*, you will not be eligible to compete in those events. Please see the **Events** tab to see these requirements. Please note that **new competitors can only compete in 3x3, 2x2, Skewb and Pyraminx**.

**Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1 - 6 UK competitors; 3x3 - 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors.

**Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Kewbz UK Championship FMC 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionshipFMC2022) on 22nd October instead. The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Kewbz UK Championship 2022.

We will be taking videos and photographs of the competition and the environment for our social media pages and website. Media persons will also be in attendance. By attending the competition as a competitor or a guest, you are accepting that you may be filmed or photographed for these purposes.

**Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete.

[![Kewbz](https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/679033331912015892/1005532291797352509/RGB_FINAL_UKC_2022_LOGO_FOR_SCREENS.png)](https://kewbz.co.uk)

Why SILENCE?

We will be trying our best to provide you all with an ambience of as much as silence and serenity as possible! Irrespective of the events... Yes, Including 3x3 and other NxN events which don't generally demand silence. :)

We aim to experiment and see how much more efficient we'd all be in an ambience more favorable for cubing. With minimal spectator pressure.

We plan have separate rooms for waiting and competing, where the competing area would only have the competitors for the round, scramblers, and judges in it.

We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a serene ambience for all the fellow cubers. 
  
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well. 
 
If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.

Happy cubing!

items.information:
##### *English version is below*

#### **Deutsch:**

Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Open 2022 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. 

Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic und delegiert von Niko Ronkainen. Diesmal findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt.

Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen!

Falls Ihr Gäste dabei habt, würden wir euch bei der Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld um die Namen eure Gäste bitten.

Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich!

-----

#### **English:**

We are happy to announce the Vienna Open 2022 as an official WCA Competition. 

The speedcubing competition is organised by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic and delegated by Niko Ronkainen. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings.

The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations.

If you bring any guests, please write their names in the comments of your registration.

Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website**. 

Note: there is of course the possibility that we will need to increase safety precautions. **Please be aware that changes may be needed.** An email will be sent out to registered competitors about significant changes if any are needed.

Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we ask that no competitor brings more than 2 guests.

Finally, please note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule - for events in the afternoon (4x4x4 and onwards), **please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance** just in case.

items.information:
NZ North Island Championship 2022 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.

In addition, NZ North Island Championship 2022 is the last regional championship of 2022 in the lead up to Nationals in December.

items.information:
A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores.

**ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades, apenas modalidades conhecidas como side events, portanto, não é uma competição indicada para iniciantes.

---

Registration is open to any person, from any country.

For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

**ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of it's events, only the ones known as side events, that said, it is not a competition indicated for beginners

# 🇺🇾
NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19.
Hay un límite de 50 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* Se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Leer toda la información disponible en esta página.

Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. 

# 🇬🇧
YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF COVID-19.
Competitor limit: 50.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)).
* Competitors must provide their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* Read all the information available in this website.

Feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

8/21に行われるYoga Summer A 2022 (**本大会 / 以下、A大会**) と8/28に行われる[Yoga Summer B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/YogaSummerB2022) (以下、B大会) は 、WCA シリーズ大会です。
### シリーズ大会では、そのうち１つだけに参加できます。
複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。

なお、A大会とB大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。
**A大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (2ラウンド) / ピラミンクス / 3x3x3 目隠し / 4x4x4 目隠し / 5x5x5 目隠し**
B大会: 3x3x3 キューブ (3ラウンド) / 2x2x2 キューブ / 4x4x4 キューブ / メガミンクス 

新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。
飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。

会場の広さの都合上、本大会の**見学申請は、競技参加者１名につき同伴者１名**に制限しています。
競技参加者１名につき２名以上の同伴や、その他**一般からの見学申請は受け付けておりません。**
また、見学希望者多数の場合は未成年の同伴者など配慮を必要とする方を優先する場合があります。

Yoga Summer A 2022 (**This competition, A**) and [Yoga Summer B 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/YogaSummerB2022) (B) are WCA Series Competitions. 
### You can register either of these series competitions.  
If you register for multiple competitions, the earliest one will only be received, and the others will be rejected.

Please make sure that the events for A and B are different.
**A: 3x3x3 Cube (2 round) / Pyraminx / 3x3x3 blindfolded / 4x4x4 blindfolded / 5x5x5 blindfolded**
B: 3x3x3 Cube (3 round) / 2x2x2 Cube / 4x4x4 Cube / Megaminx 

The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure.
**Spectators are only permitted as companions of competitors.**
Being mindful of space, we require that **each competitor bring at most 1 guest.**
If the number of requests would become too many,  a certain prioritization might be applied. (Ex. Guardians for minors)

# Competitors may bring at most one guest. This will be checked at the entrance of the competition. No external spectators are allowed, only those coming with a confirmed competitor will be allowed in the venue.
# All attendees (competitors + guests) must show valid proof of at least one of the following two requirements to be allowed in the venue:
##### 1) They are fully vaccinated against COVID-19. To clarify, an individual is only considered fully vaccinated if they have received their second dose of a two-dose vaccine (Pfizer or Moderna) or their only dose of a single-dose vaccine (J&J) more than two weeks before the competition. Any dose received after Saturday, July 30th is insufficient for entrance to the competition.
##### **OR** 
##### 2) They tested negative for COVID-19 within 96 hours (4 days) of the competition. The date when the test is conducted is what matters, not the date when the results are received. Any test conducted earlier than Tuesday, August 9th is insufficient for entrance to the competition. 
#### 
##### Along with a full vaccination or negative test document, a valid ID must be shown and checked at the registration desk on the day of the competition. Any proof sent electronically to the organizers and/or delegates prior to the competition will not be accepted. 
#####

items.information:
午前に行われる大田2022夏 (以下、AM大会) と午後に行われる大田BLD2022夏 (以下、PM大会) は 、WCA Competition Requirements Policy で定められているところの「Series Competitions」となります。
このため、いずれかの大会の申込みのみが承認されます。
両方に申込んだ場合は、申込日時が早い方を受理し、申込日時が遅い方は無効とします。悪しからずご了承ください。

なお、AM大会とPM大会は開催種目が異なります。ご留意ください。

* AM大会は、3x3x3 キューブの1種目のみです。
* PM大会は、3x3x3 目隠しの1種目のみです。


新型コロナウイルス感染症 (COVID-19) 対策のため、本大会では会場への入場者数を制限しています。
飛び込みでの競技参加や見学はできません。
見学を希望の場合、実行委員会宛に大会2日前までにメールを送ってください。 詳細は「見学の申請」のタブをご確認ください。


Ota Summer 2022  (AM) and Ota Blind Summer 2022 (PM) are "Series Competitions" defined in the WCA Competition Requirements Policy.
Therefore, you can register either of these competitions. If you register for both competitions, the earlier one will only be recieved, and the later one will be rejected.

Please make sure that the events for AM and PM are different.

* AM holds only one event, the 3x3x3 cube.
* PM holds only one event, the 3x3x3 blindfolded.




The number of persons in the venue is controlled as a COVID-19 countermeasure.
If you are not a competitor or their guest and that you want to observe the competition, please be sure to email the organization team before 28th July.
Please find "Request of observation as a visitor" tab in detail.

* **Regular 3x3x3 will NOT be held at this competition**.

Polish Speedcubing Championship is the most important event of the year of every Polish speedcuber. Since 2005 it continues to attract best competitors who compete for national titles in all events sanctioned by World Cube Association.

After successful 2021 edition this year's championship will be held in a special place - Olivia Star! Once again competing at the highest level will be accompanied by amazing views from 34th floor of Olivia Star building - highest scyscraper in northern Poland!

items.information:
Dans un soucis de satisfaire le plus grand nombre de personnes, nous souhaitons proposer - aux personnes inscrites en liste d'attente - les places des compétiteurs qui ne seraient pas venus.
Nous ne saurons avec précision le nombre de places libres que juste avant le tutoriel pour les nouveaux compétiteurs : dimanche à 9h00 nous regarderons donc si des personnes ne se sont pas présentées, et nous proposerons ces places aux personnes de la liste d'attente présentes, dans l'ordre de leur inscription.
Si vous êtes sur liste d'attente vous pouvez venir dimanche matin au cas où une place se libère, mais nous ne pouvons pas garantir que vous pourrez participer, et l'accès à la salle se fera en fonction de l'affluence.

Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule). Merci également de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription**; bien que très longues. Elles contiennent beaucoup d'informations très utiles.


----

Since we want to make as many competitors happy as we can, we would like to offer - to the competitors on the waiting list - the spots of the registered competitors who didn't show up.
We can only be sure about the number of no-shows at the beginning of the tutorial for new competitors : therefore on Sunday at 9:00, if spots are available, we will offer them to the people on the waiting list, in their registration order.
If you are on the waiting list you can come on sunday morning in case a spot is free, but we can't guarantee that you will be able to participate.

Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule). Also, **please read the registration conditions carefully**, although they are very long. They contain a lot of very useful information.

items.information:
Dans un soucis de satisfaire le plus grand nombre de personnes, nous souhaitons proposer - aux personnes inscrites en liste d'attente - les places des compétiteurs qui ne seraient pas venus.
Nous ne saurons avec précision le nombre de places libres que juste avant le premier tour du 3x3 : dimanche à 9h15 nous regarderons donc si des personnes ne se sont pas présentées, et nous proposerons ces places aux personnes de la liste d'attente présentes, dans l'ordre de leur inscription.
Si vous êtes sur liste d'attente vous pouvez venir dimanche matin au cas où une place se libère, mais nous ne pouvons pas garantir que vous pourrez participer, et l'accès à la salle se fera en fonction de l'affluence.


Pensez à consulter les onglets, en particulier celui du [planning](#competition-schedule). Merci également de **lire attentivement les conditions d'inscription**, elles contiennent beaucoup d'informations très utiles. 
En raison de la situation sanitaire, cette compétition aura un déroulement différent d'une compétition habituelle. Merci de **lire attentivement l'onglet [COVID-19](#18846-covid-19)** pour plus d'informations.

----

Since we want to make as many competitors happy as we can, we would like to offer - to the competitors on the waiting list - the spots of the registered competitors who didn't show up.
We can only be sure about the number of no-shows at the beginning of the 3x3 first round: therefore on Sunday at 9:15, if spots are available, we will offer them to the people on the waiting list, in their registration order, and those who are here will be able to compete in 3x3.

If you are on the waiting list you can come in case a spot opens up, but we can't guarantee you will be able to compete, and entering the competition area will be possible only if there is enough room left.
Make sure to read the information in the tabs, especially the one with the [schedule](#competition-schedule). Also, **please read the registration conditions carefully**, they contain a lot of very useful information.
Because of the sanitary situation, this competition will not look like an usual competition. **Please read the [COVID-19](#18846-covid-19) tab carefully** for more information.

items.information:
### General Information

This competition will take place as part of the Arnold Classic Sport Festival. Please note that due to the nature of the festival the venue will be extremely noisy, and this is outside of our control. The competition will be taking place in a large tent, and it is June, so dress warmly.

### Competitor Tickets

Please register for the competition and select your events [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArnoldClassicAfrica2022/register), and then pay for your registration at:
https://www.quicket.co.za/events/175059-speed-cubing-arnold-classic-africa/#/
Tickets for competitors cost R200, which includes access to the rest of the expo and sport festival.


### Guests

Spectators are welcome, but will need to pay for entrance to the expo. Tickets can be bought online through [WebTickets](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420) or paid for at the door. Various pricing options are available depending on whether you wish to attend for the whole weekend or just one day.
**[Tickets for guests](https://www.webtickets.co.za/v2/EventCategories.aspx?itemid=1513459420)**

### Volunteering

We will require volunteers to support with running and judging on the day. If you would like to volunteer to help staff at the competition, please contact the organisers. Groups will be assigned so that volunteer duties don't clash with your competing.

items.information:
# 🇺🇾
NO SE DEBE ASISTIR A LA COMPETENCIA CON SÍNTOMAS DE LA ENFERMEDAD COVID-19.
Hay un límite de 40 competidores para el registro.

* Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes.
* Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución.
* Recomendamos que se asista con **máximo un acompañante**, ya que no podemos asegurar que haya suficientes lugares para que todos se puedan sentar.
* Se debe tener en cuenta que el Delegado de la WCA puede descalificar a cualquier competidor cuyo comportamiento constituya un riesgo para la salud de los demás. No se realizan reembolsos por descalificación, según la regla [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1) del Reglamento de la WCA.
* Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles.
* Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento.
* Leer toda la información disponible en esta página.

**¡Importante!**

**La competencia puede ser cancelada por la Junta Directiva de la WCA si la situación de la pandemia empeora.**

Ante cualquier duda consultar al organizador o el Delegado de la WCA. 

# 🇬🇧
YOU MUST NOT SHOW UP AT THE COMPETITION WITH SYMPTOMS OF COVID-19.
Competitor limit: 40.

* Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue.
* This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age.
* It is strongly recommended to bring a maximum of **one guest per competitor**, given that there will not be enough seats for everyone.
* Please, remember that the WCA Delegate may disqualify any competitor that behaves in a way that is unsafe for other people's health inside the venue (see regulation [2k3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k3)). A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition (regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1)).
* Competitors must provide their own puzzles.
* Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations.
* Read all the information available in this website.

**Attention!**

**The competition may be canceled by the WCA Board if the pandemic situation gets worse.**

Feel free to contact the organizer or the WCA Delegate.

items.name: BC Cubing Springback B 2022
items.information:
Luke, Lindy, and Kevin are happy to invite you again or perhaps for your very first time to the heart of Coquitlam for 2022’s first of the year in BC event for cubing, competing and connecting together! It is spring and we are bringing cubing back to BC!

Welcome upcoming competitors and guests to the BC Cubing Springback B 2022 (or A!)

Both A and B competitions are part of a Series Competition. Both fall over the Victoria Day May Long Weekend, with Competition A scheduled for the Sunday and Competition B for the Monday Statutory Holiday here in this province. Registration is permitted only for ONE of these series competitions; no competitor may register for both but must choose A (Sunday May 22) OR choose B (Monday May 23 stat holiday Victoria Day).

This competition is in part a show of support for the Ukrainian people at this time.  Each registered competitor paying a competition fee allows cubers all together to make a charitable contribution to the World Food Programme Ukraine Emergency Appeal. Help is  urgently needed  for providing emergency food and water to Ukraine and the neighbouring countries affected by the war and its devastating humanitarian crisis. We pledge to donate 20% of all competition fees collected to go toward this important, very needy appeal. See [the World Food Programme website](https://www.wfp.org/support-us/stories/ukraine-appeal?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=16413288686&utm_content=136717956471&gclid=CjwKCAiAsYyRBhACEiwAkJFKos8xSLAQ3GFVytXqMxvY4c1VkBVL6kpViN8WN2_WgBe3xP6p0vxTFBoCol8QAvD_BwE&gclsrc=aw.ds).

The recent and greatly anticipated changes to BC Public Health Order which applies also to social gatherings and events means that we will not be seeking the proof of vaccination status of competitors and guests in May. Happily, masking will be an option at the venue as well.  As an expected and still valuable courtesy,  we simply ask that those experiencing any COVID-19 like symptoms or those with a recent positive COVID-19 test refrain from attending. Competitors may arrange with the organisational team for a full refund if they need to opt out due to the onset of illness or a positive test. Naturally we have a Staying Health Informed tab here on the website to share any useful considerations pertaining to personal wellness at the competition and as a place to communicate any additional changes to the new health order - if the government re-introduces restrictions such as proof of vaccination or masks, we will update the website and email registered competitiors.

Registration with a $25 CDN payment through Stripe opens Friday April 1st 6:00pm PST.

Note that registration will close one week later. No on the spot registrations will be accepted.
Registration is first come, first served based on the order of when payment through Stripe is received.
A waitlist will be maintained for those unable to secure a spot in the competition.
See the Waitlisted Competitors Tab.

BY REGISTERING, YOU AGREE THAT YOU UNDERSTAND AND WILL FOLLOW ALL OF THE HEALTH AND SAFETY MEASURES LISTED IN THE HEALTH AND SAFETY TAB AND ACCEPT IF ANY OF THE MEASURES NEED TO BE NUANCED CLOSER TO THE DATE OF COMPETITION.

We look forward to a full house of 60 competitors!

Spectators can attend for free. Being mindful of space, we require that no competitor brings more than 2 guests.

items.name: Hive Blind 2022
items.information:
Välkommen till Hive Blind 2022, som hålls i centrala Stockholm. Detta är en sista chans att kvalificera sig inför [Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Euro2022) i juli. Alla är varmt välkomna att tävla, men kom ihåg att denna tävling endast håller utvalda sido- och blindgrenar. Vänligen läs igenom alla flikar på denna sida för att se till att du inte missar någon viktig information om tävlingen.

### Vänligen notera:
* **Vi förväntar oss en mycket hög efterfrågan jämfört med antalet tillgängliga deltagarplatser för den här tävlingen, så om du vill ha en plats måste du antagligen anmäla dig direkt när registreringen öppnar.** Anmälan öppnar tisdagen den 26:e april, klockan 20:00 svensk tid.
* **Varje deltagare får ta med högst en gäst till denna tävling. Varje gäst måste betala en inträdesavgift på 20 SEK för att få komma in i lokalen.** Läs "extra registration requirements" för mer information.
* **Lokalen ligger i matsalen på en kontorsarbetsplats med hög fysisk säkerhet och du kommer inte att kunna komma och gå som du vill.** Du måste antingen anlända till ytterdörren senast fem minuter innan den första grenen ska starta, eller ge dig själv gott om tid innan din första gren för att se till att någon har tid att släppa in dig. Information om telefonnummer till utvalda Hive Streaming-anställda kommer att mailas till dig dagen innan tävlingen, i fall du behöver ringa någon för att släppa in dig på kontoret.

---

Welcome to Hive Blind 2022, held in downtown Stockholm. This is a last-chance-to qualify competition before the [Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Euro2022) in July. Everyone is warmly welcome to compete, but remember that this competition only holds selected side and blind events. Please read through all tabs on this site to make sure you don't miss any important information about the competition.

### Please note: 
* **We expect very high demand compared to available spots for this competition, so if you want a spot, you will likely need to register the very second when registration opens.** Registration opens on Tuesday 26th April, at 20:00 Swedish time.
* **Every competitor can bring at most one guest to this competition. Every attending guest will have to pay an entry fee of 20 SEK to be allowed inside the venue.** Please read the extra registration requirements for more information.
* **The venue is located in the canteen of an office workplace with a high level of physical security, and you will not be able to come and go as you please.** You must either arrive at the front door no later than five minutes before the first event is scheduled to start, or give yourself ample time before your first event to make sure that someone can find the time to let you in. Details of contact phone numbers to selected Hive Streaming employees will be emailed to you the day before the competition, in case you need to call someone to let you in to the office.

items.information:
[FR]

En accord avec la politique de santé publique et les directives de l'ÉTS, tous les compétiteurs et leurs accompagnateurs devront porter un masque à l'intérieur des bâtiments. Le port du couvre-visage en tissu est interdit. Dans l'éventualité où les directives changent, les compétiteurs seront avisés par courriel.

Portez une attention particulière à l'onglet Santé & Sécurité.

**Les étudiants de l'ÉTS peuvent s'inscrire sans frais**. Si vous êtes étudiant de l'ÉTS, vous devez réserver votre place sur le [portail de réservation](https://reservation.etsmtl.ca/Accueil.aspx) dans monÉTS dans la section "Activités de la vie étudiante". Vous devez enregistrer au plus tard le vendredi 15 avril à 15h. Une fois que c'est fait j'aurais la liste des étudiants qui n'auront pas besoin de payer. Vous devez donc ensuite vous inscrire sur le site web WCA en même temps que tout le monde, simplement vous n'aurez pas à payer les frais d'inscription. Je précise que vous devez enregister le plus tôt possible, car être enregistré sur le portail de réservation ne vous garantie pas une place dans la compétition.

Il n'y aura **aucun remboursement en cas d'annulation** (à cause des frais de transaction). Cependant si vous vous inscrivez et que vous n'êtes finalement pas en mesure de venir, merci de nous en informer afin de donner la place à quelqu'un d'autre. Les personnes inscrites en file d'attente seront remboursées une fois la période d'inscription s'est fermée.

[EN]

As per the current public health policy and the directives of the university, all competitors and their guest must wear a mask at all time inside the buildings. Wearing a cloth mask is prohibited. We will send registered competitors further details in an email if the regulations change. 

Take clear note especially of the Health and Safety Tab.

**ETS students may compete for free**. If you are an ETS student, you must reserve your place on the [reservation portal](https://reservation.etsmtl.ca/Accueil.aspx) on monÉTS in the "Activités de la vie étudiante" section. You must register there by Friday, April 15 at 15h. Once you register there I will have the list of students who do not need to pay. You can then register on the WCA site without paying the fee. You should register as quickly as possible, as being registered on the monÉTS portal does not guarantee you a place in the competition.

There will be **no refunds in case of cancellation** (due to transaction fees) . However, if you register and you are not able to come, please let us know so we can give the spot to someone else. You will still be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the the registration period closes.

items.name: Oficina Open 2022
items.information:
# REGISTRO

A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos:

1.	Tomar todos os cuidados referente ao COVID-19 e seguir o que será indicado pelo delegado e organizador da competição;
2.	Conhecer as regras da WCA, pois é uma competição oficial;
3.	Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Preste atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites;
4.	Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 25,00 (inscrição+camiseta) pagos antecipadamente por meio de depósito bancário ou pix. Não serão aceitas inscrições no dia do campeonato.
Conta para deposito: Banco Itau | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01.
5.	Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do e-mail (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), bem como o delegado por meio do e-mail (pmiranda@worldcubeassociation.org).

O acesso ao local será permitido mediante comprovação de esquema vacinal completo, ou  teste negativo para Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no local, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento (para o competidor e o acompanhante). Para as crianças menores de 12 anos, será solicitado o teste negativo de Covid-19 do tipo PCR, realizado até 48 horas antes do ingresso no estabelecimento, ou do tipo antígeno, realizado até 24 horas antes do acesso ao local. Essas regras podem ser mais restritas ou flexibilizadas conforme orientações dos órgãos governamentais até a data do evento.

------------

**REGISTRATION**

The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements:

1.	Take all precautions regarding COVID-19 and follow what will be indicated by the delegate and the organizer;
2.	Being familiar with the WCA rules, since this is an official competition;
3.	Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind.
4.	Register through the WCA website.The registration fee is R$25,00 (registration+shirt) paid in advance by bank transfer or Pix. Registration at competition day will not be allowed.
Bank Account:  Itau Bank | Ag. 7021 | CC 05400-7 -> Pix 103552998-01.
5.	For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (antonio.cecchini@gmail.com), or the delegate via email  (pmiranda@worldcubeassociation.org).

Access to the venue will be allowed upon proof of the complete vaccination schedule, or a negative test for Covid-19 of the PCR type, took up to 48 hours before entering the venue, or of the antigen type, took up to 24 hours before entry into the establishment (for both competitor and companion). For children under 12 years of age, a negative Covid-19 PCR test will be required, took within 48 hours before entering the establishment, or an antigen test took within 24 hours before entering the venue. These rules may be changed to be more restrictive or flexible based upon governmental mandates until the event date.
